integrity: The base local spaces and Plotkin extension are independently reconstructed from the source formulas. The three-block recurrence is proved from independence of three distinct kernel-block evaluation functionals and the doubled-parent geometry. A standalone verifier checks both length-32 bases exactly and validates the closed forms against the recurrences through ten extensions.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the two- and three-block levels for the recursively constructed exceptional pair \(H^{1,1,t-4}\) and \(\bar H^{2,0,t-5}\), \(t\ge5\). It does not determine the full multi-block hierarchy for arbitrary \(\ell\) or classify all additive Hadamard codes of the same abstract types.
title: Three-block rank distributions for the exceptional Hadamard pair
